headline: Trump Dozes Off After Own Jab

beats.text: Just days after mocking eighty-three-year-old Joe Biden as 'Sleepy Joe' over his age and stamina, Trump starred in his own Oval Office nap during a drug-pricing victory lap.

beats.caption: Thank you very much, President Trump, for your leadership.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. kept piling on the praise. About fifteen minutes in, cameras caught the eighty-year-old president's eyes drooping shut.

beats.caption: And, uh, it's all thanks to you, because nobody thought that this was possible.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: Multiple outlets clocked his eyes shut for more than twenty seconds, head tilted, before he straightened up just in time to take credit.

beats.caption: Thank you, Howard. And you know, just uh, the enthusiasm, you know, you hear these three guys. I hear them all the time.
beats.label: via The White House
